acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0007 of 2017 (Fees Rules)

en.title: FEES Schedules 10 and 11: no start date and no cap for the daily surcharge on unpaid late fees
en.summary: "Non-payment of the late fee within 30 calendar days incurs a further late payment fee equal to 10% of the late fee for each calendar day" (5% in Schedule 11). The text does not say from which day the 30 days run (the contravention, the end of the 3 or 5 business days, or an invoice) and sets no cap on the surcharge (the AFSA may waive fees under FEES 5.1.3).
en.correction: Please state when the late fee becomes payable and when the daily charge starts, and confirm whether an upper limit is intended.
